definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture for sitting, typically with a back and four legs. Can refer to any type of chair.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{椅子|いす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りません→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{椅子|いす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This chair is expensive, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{椅子|いす}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{持|も}ってきて→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There aren't enough chairs in the meeting room, so please bring some from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{椅子|いす}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{疲|つか}れない→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This chair doesn't make you tired even if you sit for a long time, so it's very convenient for working.

notes:
{椅子|いす} is the general word for chair, often written in hiragana as いす.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {椅子|いす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit on a chair
- {椅子|いす}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand up from a chair
- {椅子|いす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to pull out a chair
- {椅子|いす}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to line up chairs

COUNTER:
⟦{脚|きゃく}→脚：noentry⟧ for chairs (because they have legs). Also つ or ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ in casual speech.

TYPES OF SEATING:
- ⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧: sofa
- ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧: bench
- ⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧{椅子|いす}: swivel chair
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧{椅子|いす}: folding chair

Note: For traditional Japanese floor seating, see ⟦{座布団|ざぶとん}→座布団：06120_zabuton⟧ (floor cushion).
